summary: The farmRoutes rules use owner-only writes, authenticated reads, public visibility gating, strict field allowlists, timestamp validation, and immutable owner fields. No unauthorized private read/write path was identified in the added route rules.

findings.issue: itemIds is constrained to a list of 1 to 250 values, but the rules do not validate every dynamic catalog id element as a string.
findings.recommendation: Keep the client-side string sanitization and consider a future map-based or backend-validated route format if route sharing becomes a sensitive or high-abuse surface.
